expression:
local({
  a <- coalesce(as.numeric(ECQ11A00), as.numeric(FCSATI00), as.numeric(GCSATI00))
  b <- coalesce(as.numeric(ECQ11B00), as.numeric(FCGDQL00), as.numeric(GCGDQL00))
  d <- coalesce(as.numeric(ECQ11C00), as.numeric(FCDOWL00), as.numeric(GCDOWL00))
  e <- coalesce(as.numeric(ECQ11D00), as.numeric(FCVALU00), as.numeric(GCVALU00))
  f <- coalesce(as.numeric(ECQ11E00), as.numeric(FCGDSF00), as.numeric(GCGDSF00))
  ifelse(a %in% 1:4, 5 - a, NA_real_) +
    ifelse(b %in% 1:4, 5 - b, NA_real_) +
    ifelse(d %in% 1:4, 5 - d, NA_real_) +
    ifelse(e %in% 1:4, 5 - e, NA_real_) +
    ifelse(f %in% 1:4, 5 - f, NA_real_)
})
